items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: He had Billard Rogan and all them people in his Twenty-Fifth Infantry

ctx.x: ...Department to let us go into the Twenty-Fifth Infantry 'cause he had the best football players, and he had the best baseball players. He had Billard Rogan and all them people in his Twenty-Fifth Infantry Band and he had the best runners. He had every best thing that the soldiers could do. He had it in his company but he never had a jazz band so he wanted a jazz band so they gave him permission so he brought us to Arizona, and we stayed down there on the border, and all this happened down there till the war was…
Oh. So, how long, altogether, were you in the service?
